steps.name: Close fountains
steps.do: Open **Close drinking fountains** for a window covering today and enter a closed message.

steps.name: Map markers/banners
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Drinking Fountains**.
steps.expect: Drinking fountain markers show closed treatment; click one and the closed message appears.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.expect: Drinking fountain markers show as open.
